title: Emotional performances in intimate venue
text: A one hour show in an intimate venue. We enjoyed spectacular Spanish guitar performances with a singer and flamenco dancer. It was emotional and we felt very close to the performers. Would recommend. Don’t be late as it starts promptly and it is a very small place so you disturb everyone if you walk in after it has started.
author: leopold25

title: Mindblowingly good!!
text: Absolutely fantastic performances in a superb, intimate show. We have seen a lot of flamenco over the years but this one was the best so far. Electric! We absolutely loved it and were totally buzzing for ages after it. Laura dances like a goddess and the guitar player and singer were sublime. A must see.
author: gilbertos

title: Fabulous Flamenco
text: Fabulous, authentic flamenco. Intimate performance, pared down and brilliant. All three artistes were super talented. Highly recommended
author: HollyWallyTeynham
